items.title: One Post in a Moms' Group Changed Everything
items.summary: In episode 1027 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Dilani Kahawala, Co-Founder and CEO of Anna, about how Anna began while her team was still testing enterprise ideas, when her lead engineer built a personal assistant on WhatsApp and she wanted one for herself. She shares how a single post in a Facebook moms' group blew up and revealed parents already trying to hack together their own assistants with tools like Claude Code.

items.title: AI Engineering red flags
items.summary: After interviewing over a hundred AI engineers, I keep seeing the same portfolio mistakes. You’ve got working code, but can someone else run it? Can you explain why you picked that model? Those are things we’ll ask about. Here are four things to check before you send us your portfolio for an AI engineering role. #short
